story.zh: 刘备驾崩后，南中耆帅雍闿煽动高定、朱褒叛乱，占越雟、牂牁二郡。雍闿又联络南中诸部，占建宁，意欲通吴拒蜀。
story.en: Following the death of Liu Bei, Yong Kai, a chieftain of Nanzhong, incited Gao Ding and Zhu Bao to rebel, seizing the commanderies of Yuesui and Zangke. Yong Kai also rallied various tribes of Nanzhong to occupy Jianning, intending to ally with Wu and resist Shu.

trigger.zh: 刘备死亡。诸葛亮、魏延、赵云、王平、马岱、马谡存活且在刘禅麾下，雍闿存活且在孟获麾下。成都、永昌属刘禅，越巂属高定，牂牁属朱褒，建宁属孟获。
trigger.en: Liu Bei is dead. Zhuge Liang, Wei Yan, Zhao Yun, Wang Ping, Ma Dai, and Ma Su are alive and serve under Liu Shan, Yong Kai is alive and serves under Meng Huo. Chengdu and Yongchang belong to Liu Shan, Yuesui belongs to Gao Ding, Zangke belongs to Zhu Bao, Jianning belongs to Meng Huo.
